title: backlog.py done --dry-run records a done.refused ops row, which ops and the retrospective read as a real refusal
goal: done --dry-run, which runs an item's checks or repro without changing anything, writes no done.refused ops row, so backlog.py ops lists only refusals of real done runs

run: import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile;H=tempfile.mkdtemp();E=dict(os.environ,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=H,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=os.getcwd());subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','done','ST-3zvgcv3n','--dry-run'],capture_output=True,env=E);hits=[os.path.join(r,f) for r,_,fs in os.walk(H) for f in fs if 'done.refused' in open(os.path.join(r,f),errors='replace').read()];print('done.refused rows written by a dry run:',hits);sys.exit(1 if hits else 0)
